init_meshRenderer: create a meshRenderer instance with width, height, and render_mode parameters for OpenGL mesh rendering
setRenderMode: switch the meshRenderer render mode between color, normal, or geo shader programs
drawMesh: render the current mesh using OpenGL vertex, normal, color, and index buffers with shader uniforms
review_meshRenderer_class: review the meshRenderer class that extends glRenderer for OpenGL-based 3D mesh visualization
refactor_drawMesh: refactor the drawMesh method to support additional buffer types or shader uniform configurations
